card.name: Bhangra
card.tagline: Energetic Punjabi harvest folk dance driven by the dhol
card.profile: Bhangra is a vigorous folk dance of the Punjab region of the Indian subcontinent, especially associated with the spring Vaisakhi harvest festival (Wikipedia). Dancers perform energetic kicks, leaps and shoulder movements to short sung couplets (boliyan) and the syncopated beat of the double-headed dhol drum (Britannica). Its purest traditional form is traced to the Sialkot area; modern staged bhangra developed in the 1950s, notably patronized by the Maharaja of Patiala who requested a performance in 1953 (Wikipedia). The Punjabi diaspora spread bhangra worldwide, fusing it with hip-hop, house and reggae.
card.insight: Originally a men's dance, bhangra drew its name from bhang (hemp), a Vaisakhi harvest product, and second-generation diaspora Punjabi women later embraced it, sometimes at the expense of the traditional women's giddha (Britannica).

lessons.title: LESSON 1 - BEGINNER BHANGRA SERIES | Fundamentals & Bhangra Footwork | BFUNK Dance Tutorials

parts.note: The two instructors introduce the beginner Bhangra series and lesson one.
Demonstration of the Bhangra footwork to music.
Explanation of fundamental footwork posture and learning the Bedi step.
Breakdown and explanation of the second footwork step, Dhamaal.

steps.name: Bedi
steps.description: A tapping motion shifting weight between legs while staying on the balls of the feet.

steps.name: Dhamaal
steps.description: A hop type motion lifting and flexing the leg with a pendulum effect.

cues: Shift your weight onto your right leg
images: It looks a little bit of a pendulum effect
common_mistakes: Slams foot down with the entire foot, which can hurt the shin
Leaving too much space in between feet during the Dhamaal step
safety: Do not slam your whole foot down to avoid injury
Stretch your hip flexors to increase range
lessons.teacher_style: The teachers break down fundamental Bhangra footwork step by step with clear verbal explanations and physical demonstrations. They emphasize posture, weight shifting, and tempo progression while maintaining an encouraging and upbeat tone.
lessons.distinctive_method: Using a two-person setup where one instructor speaks and guides while the other demonstrates alongside in a mirrored position.
what_works: Clear visual demonstration alongside verbal instructions
Breaking down movements at a slower count before picking up the tempo
what_hinders: Rapid transitions between detailed explanations and full-speed demonstrations

evidence.observation: Teacher stands facing front with hands on hips, explaining knee posture and weight placement while another instructor stands behind in mirror view.
evidence.cannot_infer: exact muscular tension and subtle weight distribution

evidence.observation: Teacher crouches down pointing at the other instructor's foot to highlight proper ball-of-foot placement versus full-foot landing.
evidence.cannot_infer: exact downward force exerted by the foot
